gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i8: Test that we can compile with assignment to the same map as the param.
ADDED i1: Tests {@link CSVRecord#putIn(Map)}, which copies a record's header-to-value mappings into a caller-supplied Map and returns that same Map.
ADDED i2: Used as the record header; the column header names are the enum constant names FIRST, SECOND and THIRD.
ADDED i3: A single CSV row whose three columns hold these values.
ADDED i4: Header name that is intentionally absent from the record.
ADDED i5: A record parsed with {@link EnumHeader} as its header, so its columns are keyed by the enum constant names FIRST, SECOND and THIRD.
ADDED i6: Asserts that {@code map} contains exactly the three header-to-value mappings produced from {@link #recordWithHeader}, and nothing for the unmapped header.
ADDED i7: putIn populates the map passed in.
